# 100 Questions

> 100 Questions is a prepaid, source-backed AI visibility benchmark. It sends one frozen 25-question set across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and xAI, then reports mentions, prominence, competitor share of voice, claimed-domain citations, provider coverage, and evidence-linked actions.

- Canonical site: https://100questionsai.com/
- Pricing: https://100questionsai.com/pricing
- Methodology: https://100questionsai.com/methodology
- Resource library: https://100questionsai.com/resources
- 2026 AI Visibility Index and open data: https://100questionsai.com/ai-visibility-index
- Sample report: https://100questionsai.com/sample-report
- Full product and methodology reference: https://100questionsai.com/llms-full.txt

## Limits

Results are time-stamped, directional API-grounded snapshots and do not claim parity with consumer chat products. AI answers vary by provider, model, grounding source, locale, and time. No technical or content tactic guarantees a mention, citation, recommendation, or ranking.
